name: Become Hungry Worm
desc:
In this game, YOU get to be the Hungry Worm 🔥

🏃‍♂️❗ Chase and eat people to grow your size and speed
🪱 Your level and size saves for next time
🤑 Climb to the WORM GOD to rebirth!
🌟 PERMANETLY upgrade your stats with rebirths!
🛒 Hatch eggs to unlock cool worm skins with special effects!

Enjoy!
